LESSON: HUMAN DIGESTIVE SYSTEM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 1.3: Human Digestive System

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Human Digestive System. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Human Digestive System
2. Practise Human Digestive System at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human Digestive System

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Human Digestive System
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Human Digestive System. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Human Digestive System at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Human Digestive System at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human Digestive System
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Human Digestive System. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Human Digestive System using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Human Digestive System in the examples.
2. Explain Human Digestive System to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Human Digestive System.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Human Digestive System using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Human Digestive System important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Human Digestive System
2. Practise Human Digestive System at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human Digestive System

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
